For the year ended 31 December 2021, the Group realized                   截至二零二一年十二月三十一日止年度，本集團營
an operating revenue of RMB211,300 million. The earnings                  業額為人民幣211,300 百萬元。母公司擁有人應佔
attributable to the owners of the parent company were RMB3,045            溢利為人民幣3,045百萬元，下滑28%，每股盈利為
million, down 28%, with the earnings per share of RMB1.06. The            人民幣1.06 元。董事會建議派發末期股息每股人民
Board suggested to distribute an ending dividend of RMB0.105              幣0.105元（含稅）。

RETIREMENT SCHEME                                                                         退休計劃
Currently, all PRC subsidiaries of the Group participate in defined                       現時本集團的各中國附屬公司參與一些由中國當地
contribution retirement schemes (the “Schemes”) launched by                               省市政府機關籌辦的定額供款退休福利計劃（「該等
local provincial and municipal governments in China, pursuant                             計劃」），據此，本集團須按合資格僱員薪金的適用
to which the Group makes contributions to the Schemes in                                  比率向該等計劃作出供款。地方政府機關就應付退
accordance with the applicable percentage of the salary of                                休僱員的全部退休金承擔責任。
eligible staff. Local government authorities assume the obligation
in respect of all the pensions payable to retired staff.

               term interest of generally not less than 20% of the equity                  份投票權之長期權益且本集團對其可行使重
               voting rights and over which it is in a position to exercise                大影響力的實體。重大影響力為參與投資對

               participate in the financial and operating policy decisions                 制或共同控制該等政策。
               of the investee, but is not control or joint control over those
               policies.

               Fair value measurement                                                  公允價值計量

               The Group measures its listed equity investments and                    本集團於各報告期末以公允價值計量其上市
               derivative financial instruments at fair value at the end of            權益投資及衍生金融工具。公允價值指市場
               each reporting period. Fair value is the price that would               參與者於計量日期在有序交易中出售資產所
               be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in         收取或轉讓負債所支付的價格。公允價值計
               an orderly transaction between market participants at the               量所依據的假設為，出售資產或轉讓負債的
               measurement date. The fair value measurement is based                   交易乃於該資產或負債的主要市場進行，或
               on the presumption that the transaction to sell the asset               如無主要市場，則於對該資產或負債最為有
               or transfer the liability takes place either in the principal           利的市場進行。本集團必須可進入該主要或
               market for the asset or liability, or in the absence of a               最為有利的市場。計量資產或負債的公允價
               principal market, in the most advantageous market for the               值使用市場參與者於為該資產或負債定價時
               asset or liability. The principal or the most advantageous              所依據的假設，即假設市場參與者按其最佳
               market must be accessible by the Group. The fair value of               經濟利益行事。
               an asset or a liability is measured using the assumptions
               that market participants would use when pricing the asset
               or liability, assuming that market participants act in their
               economic best interest.


               A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into            非金融資產公允價值的計量參考市場參與者
               account a market participant’s ability to generate economic             可從使用該資產得到的最高及最佳效用，或
               benefits by using the asset in its highest and best use or              把該資產售予另一可從使用該資產得到最高
               by selling it to another market participant that would use              及最佳效用的市場參與者所產生的經濟效
               the asset in its highest and best use.                                  益。


               The Group uses valuation techniques that are appropriate                本集團使用適用於不同情況的估值方法，而
               in the circumstances and for which sufficient data are                  其有足夠數據計量公允價值，並盡量利用相
               available to measure fair value, maximising the use of                  關可觀察輸入數據及盡量減少使用不可觀察
               relevant observable inputs and minimising the use of                    輸入數據。
               unobservable inputs.

49.   FAIR VALUE AND FAIR VALUE HIERARCHY OF                          49.   金融工具之公允價值及公允價值層級
      FINANCIAL INSTRUMENTS
      Management has assessed that the fair values of restricted            管理層已評估受限制銀行存款、現金及現金
      bank deposits, cash and cash equivalents, pledged                     等價物、已抵押存款、應收貿易賬款、應付
      deposits, trade receivables, trade and bills payables,                貿易賬款及票據、計入預付款項、其他應收
      financial assets included in prepayments, other receivables           賬款及其他資產的金融資產、計入其他應付
      and other assets, financial liabilities included in other             款項及應計費用的金融負債、應收 ╱ 應付合
      payables and accruals, amounts due from/to joint ventures             營公司及聯營公司款項及應收 ╱ 應付其他關
      and associates and amounts due from/to other related                  聯方款項的公允價值與其賬面值相若，此乃
      parties approximate to their carrying amounts largely due             主要由於該等工具均屬於短期性質。
      to the short-term maturities of these instruments.


      The Group’s corporate finance team headed by the finance              本集團企業融資團隊由融資經理領導，負責
      manager is responsible for determining the policies and               釐定金融工具公允價值計量之政策及程序。
      procedures for the fair value measurement of financial                企業融資團隊直接向財務總監及審核委員會
      instruments. The corporate finance team reports directly              報告。於各報告日期，企業融資團隊分析金
      to the chief financial officer and the audit committee. At            融工具之價值變動及釐定應用於估值之主要
      each reporting date, the corporate finance team analyses              輸入數字。估值交由財務總監審核及批准。
      the movements in the values of financial instruments and              財務總監與審核委員會每年就中期及年度財
      determines the major inputs applied in the valuation. The             務報告的估值程序及結果進行兩次討論。
      valuation is reviewed and approved by the chief financial
      officer. The valuation process and results are discussed
      with the audit committee twice a year for interim and annual
      financial reporting.


      The fair values of the financial assets and liabilities are           金融資產及負債的公允價值乃各自願人士之
      included at the amount at which the instrument could be               間進行現時交易時工具可予以匯兌的價格，

               AND POLICIES
               The Group’s principal financial instruments, other than               本 集 團 的 主 要 金 融 工 具（ 衍 生 金 融 工 具 除
               derivative financial instruments, comprise interest-bearing           外）包括計息銀行及其他借款、受限制銀行

               finance for the Group’s operations. The Group has                     債，如直接自其業務產生的應收貿易賬款及
               various other financial assets and liabilities such as trade          應付貿易賬款。
               receivables and trade payables, which arise directly from
               its operations.


               The main risks arising from the Group’s financial                     本集團金融工具所產生的主要風險為利率風
               instruments are interest rate risk, foreign currency risk,            險、外匯風險、信貸風險及流動資金風險。
               credit risk and liquidity risk. The Group’s accounting                本集團有關衍生金融工具的會計政策載於合
               policies in relation to derivative financial instruments are          併財務報表附註2.4。
               set out in note 2.4 to the consolidated financial statements.


               Interest rate risk                                                    利率風險

               The Group’s exposure to the risk of changes in market                 本集團面對的市場利率變動風險主要與本集
               interest rates relates primarily to the Group’s long-term             團的浮息長期債務責任有關。

                mix of fixed and variable rate debts. At 31 December 2021,           理其利息成本。於二零二一年十二月三十一
                approximately 58% (2020: 56%) of the Group’s interest-               日，本集團約58%（二零二零年：56%）的計
